import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
im=np.array(Image.open('chess_board.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
sq=80
light=np.array([240,217,181]); dark=np.array([181,136,99])
items=[]
for r in range(8):
    for c in range(8):
        block=im[r*sq:(r+1)*sq,c*sq:(c+1)*sq]
        bg = light if (r+c)%2==0 else dark
        d=np.abs(block-bg).sum(axis=2)
        mask=d>60
        if mask.mean()>0.03:
            ys,xs=np.where(mask)
            # don't crop too tight? crop bounding box
            m=mask[ys.min():ys.max()+1, xs.min():xs.max()+1]
            # resize to 32x32
            img=Image.fromarray((m*255).astype('uint8')).resize((32,32))
            a=np.array(img)>128
            color='black' if block[mask][:,0].mean()<80 else 'white'
            items.append((r,c,color,a))
# pairwise distance normalized
n=len(items)
D=np.zeros((n,n))
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        D[i,j]=np.logical_xor(items[i][3],items[j][3]).mean()
# cluster greedy
for_thr=0.12
used=[False]*n
clusters=[]
for i in range(n):
    if used[i]: continue
    grp=[i]; used[i]=True
    for j in range(i+1,n):
        if not used[j] and D[i,j]<for_thr:
            grp.append(j); used[j]=True
    clusters.append(grp)
for gi,grp in enumerate(clusters):
    print('CLUSTER',gi)
    for idx in grp:
        r,c,col,a=items[idx]
        print(f'  r{r}c{c} {col}')
# print distance matrix small
print('items',[(it[0],it[1],it[2]) for it in items])

from PIL import Image
from collections import deque
im=Image.open('chess_board.png').convert('RGB')
px=im.load(); W,H=im.size
light=(240,217,181); dark=(181,136,99)
def ispiece(x,y):
    r=y//80; c=x//80
    bg=light if (r+c)%2==0 else dark
    p=px[x,y]
    return abs(p[0]-bg[0])+abs(p[1]-bg[1])+abs(p[2]-bg[2])>60
seen=bytearray(W*H)
comps=[]
for y in range(H):
    for x in range(W):
        idx=y*W+x
        if seen[idx] or not ispiece(x,y): continue
        q=deque([(x,y)]); seen[idx]=1
        pts=[]
        while q:
            cx,cy=q.popleft(); pts.append((cx,cy))
            for nx,ny in ((cx+1,cy),(cx-1,cy),(cx,cy+1),(cx,cy-1)):
                if 0<=nx<W and 0<=ny<H:
                    ni=ny*W+nx
                    if not seen[ni] and ispiece(nx,ny):
                        seen[ni]=1; q.append((nx,ny))
        if len(pts)>=10:
            xs=[p[0] for p in pts]; ys=[p[1] for p in pts]
            cols=[px[p] for p in pts[::max(1,len(pts)//50)]]
            mr=sum(c[0] for c in cols)/len(cols); mg=sum(c[1] for c in cols)/len(cols); mb=sum(c[2] for c in cols)/len(cols)
            comps.append((len(pts),min(xs),min(ys),max(xs),max(ys),round(mr),round(mg),round(mb)))
comps.sort(key=lambda t:(t[2]//80,t[1]//80,-t[0]))
print('num comps',len(comps))
for comp in comps:
    print(comp)
